codeReview.summary: All four utilities (truncate, runeWidth, center, padOrTruncate) were correctly extracted from entity_list.go and small_primitives.go into utils.go. The dead rune-array phantom allocation in center() was removed — the old code built a []rune slice then discarded it in favor of strings.Repeat + concatenation; the new code uses only the correct path. All six importing files (entity_list.go, small_primitives.go, detail_pane.go, tabs.go, drawer.go, stream_viewer.go) call the utilities without any import changes since they're all in the same package. The utils_test.go has 11 table-driven tests covering ASCII, CJK, mixed widths, combining marks, ZWJ emoji, and edge cases — all pass. go test -race -count=1 passes, go vet passes.

issues.description: The center() function handles ASCII padding correctly but the centering formula (pad := (width - sw) / 2) produces asymmetric results when (width - sw) is odd — the extra space goes to the right side. This is standard behavior and the tests confirm expected behavior, so no change is required.
